name: n8n
tagline: Open-source workflow automation with AI nodes
description: n8n is a source-available workflow automation tool that can be self-hosted for complete data control. It features a visual node editor, 400+ integrations, JavaScript/Python code nodes, and first-class AI support including LangChain nodes, vector store nodes, AI agents, and memory nodes. n8n's AI Agent capability lets you build autonomous agents that use tools and reason across multi-step tasks. Popular with technical teams and enterprises needing data sovereignty.
pricingDetails: Self-hosted: free (source-available, fair-code licence). n8n Cloud: Starter $24/month, Pro $60/month, Enterprise: custom.
